name: Rockpool Village
summary: Rockpool Village is a seaside settlement nestled along the eastern coast of the Blasted Lands. Originally inhabited by the Rockpool tribe of murlocs, the village was violently seized by the hostile Bloodwash naga.

sections.title: A Conquered Shore
sections.body: Tucked away along the Red Reaches on the Blasted Lands' eastern coastline, Rockpool Village was once a quiet enclave for the Rockpool murlocs. That precarious existence ended when the Bloodwash naga surged from the ocean depths. Rather than simply driving the tribe out, the serpentine invaders captured the village outright and enslaved the remaining murloc populace. Today, the settlement stands under harsh naga control, with its former residents forced into cruel subjugation beneath the overlooking bluffs.

faq.answer: Rockpool Village lies along the eastern coast of the Blasted Lands, in the coastal strip known as the Red Reaches.

faq.q: Who lives in Rockpool Village now?
faq.answer: The settlement is dominated by the Bloodwash naga, who conquered the village and forced the surviving Rockpool murlocs into servitude.
Neptool was the chieftain of the Rockpool tribe. Following the conquest of his home by the naga, his ghost lingers on the roadway overlooking the village below.

faq.q: Why did the naga take the village?
faq.answer: The Bloodwash naga pushed ashore along the Red Reaches to secure a foothold on the mainland, seizing the village to subjugate and enslave the native murlocs.
